description: This file contains utility functions for filesystem operations such as writing a file if changed, removing a file if it exists, and removing directories or paths if they exist.

methods.name: writeTextFileIfChanged
methods.description: Writes contents to a specified file only if the contents have changed, creating directories as needed.

methods.name: removeFileIfExists
methods.description: Removes a specified file if it exists, forcing removal without throwing errors.

methods.name: removePathIfExists
methods.description: Removes a directory or path recursively if it exists.
